name: Quebec City
about: Winters are genuinely harsh, but Carnaval de Québec turns that into one of the world's largest winter festivals; fall foliage and the summer Festival d'été are the other two headline windows.
overview: The only fortified city north of Mexico still standing, with a French-Canadian culture and language distinct from the rest of the country.
costOverview: Coffee, poutine, and local transit all stay reasonable — genuinely one of the better-value historic capitals in North America.

scenic.label: Summer bloom in the Old Town

specialSeasons.text: Carnaval de Québec brings ice sculptures, night parades and an ice palace to the fortified Old Town — one of the world's largest winter carnivals.
Festival d'été de Québec, one of Canada's largest music festivals, fills the city for eleven days.
Fall foliage across the Old Town and nearby Laurentians is some of the most vivid in eastern Canada.
